param.name: chrom1_name
param.label: Chromosome expected to be gained in tumor cells
param.help: Name/ID of the chromosome expected to show increased expression ('gain') in tumor cells, as it appears in the gene annotation column above. This whole-chromosome gain/loss classification applies to any condition with known chromosome-arm-level copy number alterations (for example glioblastoma, where chromosome 7 is typically gained — the default) — confirm this pattern applies to your dataset before using it.

param.name: chrom2_name
param.label: Chromosome expected to be lost in tumor cells
param.help: Name/ID of the chromosome expected to show decreased expression ('loss') in tumor cells, as it appears in the gene annotation column above (default: chromosome 10, matching the glioblastoma example of chromosome 10 loss). This applies to any condition with known chromosome-arm-level copy number alterations; as with the gained chromosome, confirm this pattern applies to your dataset.
